milestone: CPU conditionals and short-circuit Boolean control flow
implementation: ConditionalExpr/LogicalExpr lower to a typed ConditionalOperation with independently checked lexical/task state. Synchronous CPU lowering uses scf.if without scheduler entries; continuation lowering uses an appended Boolean Branch instruction and existing copies/joins. not reuses Bool equality. Bool fail contexts support conditional rethrow. Metal dispatch explicitly rejects the new CPU-only instruction.

contract.if: completed CPU Bool; mandatory else; evaluate condition once and only one branch
contract.logical: Bool-only and/or short-circuit; not negates once; no truthiness
contract.precedence: calls/signs, product, sum, pipeline, comparison, not, and, or, catch
contract.branches: lexically scoped; common builtin/numeric identity, category/rank/residency; join differing extents dynamically
contract.static_validation: both paths checked including literal conditions; no conditional frontend constant evaluator
contract.tasks: no handle escape; branch-local children observed locally; incoming children/errors discharged on all paths
contract.errors: selected operations retain source locations; skipped calls do not propagate errors; Bool fail/rethrow supported
contract.allocation: skipped tensor work allocates nothing; selected failures publish no value

qualification.scope: Focused control-flow, Boolean, frontend, worker and Metal regressions; not the full 349-test suite
coverage: all six numeric scalar result types, raw boundary/random bits including signed zero, subnormals, infinities and quiet/signaling NaN payloads
eight ARM FP environments, no FP flags and settled owners
dynamic truth tables and precedence for and/or/not; selected/unselected right-side faults
if condition failures, selected branch failures, lexical shadowing and nested branches
ordinary recursive function with base conditional, and no scheduler entries for synchronous branches
dynamic tensor extent joins, retained exact data, allocation failure sweeps and no partial results
unselected tensor work performs zero allocation even under injected first-allocation failure
both worker branches, branch-local nested scopes, cached awaits and skipped task submission
owned tensor recovery and conditional Bool fail/rethrow with original fault location
retained matrix results through conditional workers for all six numeric types
task-obligation rejection when only some paths await, no task escape, strict Bool typing and forged IR rejection
invalid branch/condition/logical diagnostics preserve existing executables

remaining_gates: broader data values/modules and native library tooling
native distributed design discussion before implementation
